ops.title: Fold cache v2 feeds the write path: bump foldCacheVersion on any fold-semantics change
ops.body:
Since v0.72.11 (#73), store.Append and PrepareAppendAt read no history on a warm tip. They take the snapshot, top lamport and extend floor from the fold cache entry (header `2 <generation> <kind> <top> <floor>` under cc-notes/folds-v2), stamp top+1, and call fold.Extend. Ops carrying a Checkpoint, a cache miss, and top+1 <= floor all keep the old path: ReadChain then fold.Strict(chain+commit).

Invariants to keep:
- Every cache put records the chain max lamport, never a wrapped commit lamport. Use putChain(tip, snap, chain) wherever the chain is in hand.
- fold.ExtendFloor is the greatest checkpoint CoversLamport, or MaxUint64 when a checkpoint State kind differs from the root create kind. It guards against seed selection flipping when a child arrives (forged or synced checkpoints).
- The cache key covers tip and op vocabulary only. A folder or engine behavior change with no new op kind must bump foldCacheVersion (and the folds-vN directory), or warm appends carry old-semantics snapshots forward to every new tip.
- Warm appends trust the cache the way Load does: object loss in already-folded history surfaces on the next cold read, push, Compact, Merge or history, not in Append.

Evidence: private copy of the monorepo ledger b29c27a (12,564 commits, 622 rows). Cold first sync took 74 s at 1.52 GB. Warm syncs took 0.77 s and 0.85 s at ~32 MB. The warm and cold `ledger show --json` outputs were byte-identical. Receipt: ~/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/2026-10-17-0620/ccn-installed-verification.json.
